data.name: Satish Parmeshwar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Satish Parmeshwar has made a big mark in cricket. With 277 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 70, with an average of 15.45 and a quick strike rate of 147.02. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 99 sixes and 356 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 634.0 overs, taking 304 wickets at an economy rate of 8.56. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
